_comment: Seed list of public ATS boards to ingest. Greenhouse uses a board token (the company slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token>); Lever uses the company slug in jobs.lever.co/<company>. Both feeds are public and need no API key. Grow this list from companies you care about and from titles you ingest via aggregators (design doc §9.2/§9.3). Copy to board_tokens.json (gitignored) before running ingest at scale.
